instruction.text:
Informational texts may also talk about a series of events in history.
Select the books on the desk to learn more.

end.text: Historical events usually contain dates. The dates can be years, months or a specific day. They help you understand the series of events.

hint.text: Look for the numbers in the sentence. They may be a date.

atoms.b: In ((1952)), after the death of her father, Princess Elizabeth became Queen of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
atoms.sound: In ((1952)), after the death of her father, Princess Elizabeth became Queen of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

atoms.b: However, it wasn’t until ((1953)) that Queen Elizabeth II was crowned.
atoms.sound: However, it wasn’t until ((1953)) that Queen Elizabeth the second was crowned.

instruction.text: What happened first? Listen and choose the right answer.

hint.text: Scroll up to check the years the events took place.

instruction.text: Sort the events into the correct order starting with what happened first.

atoms.b: Since 2015, Queen Elizabeth II has been recognised as the longest-reigning queen in the world.
When she passed away in 2022, Queen Elizabeth II was also the oldest living queen worldwide.
